current_status.from: Expired by its 12-month term (June 2024) without a captured replacement ordinance. The Madison County Planning and Zoning page, refetched with a real Chrome browser on 2026-04-30, lists exactly five published ordinances — Land Use, Watershed Protection, Mountain Ridge Protection, Noise, and Subdivision — and does not list any data-processing-facility or cryptocurrency-specific ordinance. Mountain Xpress and BPR site searches return no Madison County replacement-ordinance article. On this evidence the moratorium most likely lapsed without replacement.
